notes: Attack horse uses row 2 while the defense zone is empty and available, otherwise row 3 while the treasure zone is empty and available, otherwise row 2 right half.
Real horses use half width only if neither horse zone nor the treasure zone is empty and available.
Abolished horse rows use treasure equipment/abolition to choose full/half presentation.
HH skill placeholders participate as occupied/unavailable slots; expanded or special slots retain real nodes within four rows.
